newsitem.title: UK: Tomkins up after Kleinwort "buy" advice.
newsitem.headline: Tomkins up after Kleinwort "buy" advice.

text.p: Shares in conglomerate Tomkins Plc rose on Tuesday as analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson issued a "buy" recommendation on the stock, traders said.
Against the trend of a generally falling UK equity market, Tomkins shares were up 4p at 269 by 1116 GMT in moderate volume of 2.3 million shares.
Analysts at Kleinwort were not immediately available for comment.
On Monday, strategists at Credit Lyonnais Laing included Tomkins shares in their list of nine shares they expected to outperform during 1997.
